name: Clarity
source:
Erin Cruxley decided to return home from her boarding school one weekend. What's waiting for her when she gets there however, is something, or someone, that she was NOT expecting to see.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21582&p=274535]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个周末，艾琳·克鲁克斯利决定从寄宿学校回家。然而，当她到达那里时，等待她的是她没想到会看到的东西或人。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21582&p=274535]引理软论坛[/url]]
